questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Painter ∶ Brush ∶∶ Doctor ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** Second word is used by the first word for their work.

Painter ∶ Brush → Brush is used by Painter for painting.

Similarly,

 
• Doctor ∶ ? → Stethoscope is a medical instrument used by a Doctor.

Hence, '**Stethoscope**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(**NOTE: **Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(5, 9, 450)

(7, 12, 840)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(First number × Second number) × 10 = Third number

 
• (5, 9, 450) → (5 × 9) × 10 = 45 × 10 = 450
 
• (7, 12, 840) → (7 × 12) × 10 = 84 × 10 = 840

Similarly,

 
• (6, 9, 540) → (6 × 9) × 10 = 54 × 10 = 540

Hence, '**(6, 9, 540)**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
A @ B means 'A is the sister of B'.

A & B means 'A is the brother of B'.

A # B means 'A is the wife of B'.

A ^ B means 'A is the mother of B'.

A + B means 'A is the father of B'.

If A & C + E ^ G # I & K + M @ O, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: C is the maternal grandfather of G.
O is the daughter of K.
M is the daughter of K.
K is the father of O.

questions.solution:
A is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
^

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

A & C + E ^ G # I & K + M @ O → A is brother of C, C is father of E, E is mother of G, G is wife of I, I is brother of K, K is father of M, M is sister of O.

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/496368278e51fd33f2bee9b301a733a33389bdc9d0f2d4fae5af0b40056affd1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/850702b4907608f878226ebcbc6ba8cd696a478a10fb8864c561138ea149e99f.png] 

1. C is the maternal grandfather of G. → True

2. O is the daughter of K. → False (As the gender of O is not known, O is either the son or daughter of K)

3. M is the daughter of K. → True

4. K is the father of O. → True

Hence, ‘**O is the daughter of K**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which option represents the correct order of the given words as they would appear in the English dictionary?

1 heated

2 healed

3 heaped

4 hedge

5 helmet
questions.solution:
The option which represents the correct order of the given words as they would appear in the English dictionary is:

2 __**heal**__ed

3 __**heap**__ed

1 __**hea**__ted

4 __**hed**__ge

5 __**hel**__met

Hence, '**2, 3, 1, 4, 5**' is the correct answer.
